# 🧭 Player Finder

Player Finder is a lightweight client-side utility mod for Minecraft that helps you quickly locate the nearest player in multiplayer worlds.

With an intuitive in-game menu and customizable HUD, Player Finder provides real-time tracking without requiring any server-side installation.

## 🎯 Features

* **Nearest Player Tracking** → Automatically detects and displays the closest player.
* **Distance Display** → Shows the exact distance in blocks.
* **Direction Indicator** → Points toward the tracked player's location.
* **Nearby Player Count** → Displays how many additional players are nearby.
* **Customizable HUD** → Move, recolor, resize, and adjust the opacity of the HUD to match your preference.
* **HUD Position Editor** → Drag the HUD anywhere on your screen and save its position.
* **Integrated Settings Menu** → Configure everything directly in-game.
* **Keybind Support** → Open the Player Finder menu using a configurable Minecraft keybind.

## ✨ Highlights

* 🖥️ **Client-side only** — No server installation required.
* ⚡ **Lightweight & optimized** — Designed for minimal FPS impact.
* 🎮 **Multiplayer friendly** — Perfect for PvP, SMPs, and team gameplay.
* 👀 **Rendered entity detection** — Detects players currently rendered by the client, even if they are outside your field of view. It does **not** scan the entire world.

## 📦 Compatibility

* ✅ Fabric
* ✅ Vanilla Minecraft
* ✅ Feather Client
* ✅ Lunar Client (Fabric)
* ✅ Minecraft 26.2

## 💡 Recommended Version

Use the latest version of Player Finder for the best performance, latest features, and ongoing compatibility improvements.
